reason: This plugin is primarily an agent workflow orchestrator for DeepSeek Harness: it packages and exposes a Chinese-localized set of AI coding skill modules so agents can discover and call them by scenario. Evidence in README and manifest files shows it is specifically a DSH skill pack (plugin entry via `index.js`/`dsh.bundle`, skill catalog integration, and workflow items like TDD/debugging/review/planning) rather than an application UI or external-service tool.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，安装后可加载 20 个中文 AI 编程技能（如测试驱动、调试、代码评审与规划），并让 agent 按场景自动匹配调用。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that loads 20 Chinese AI coding skills (such as TDD, debugging, code review, and planning) and lets the agent match and call them automatically by scenario.

capabilities: Registers and exposes a set of DSH skills for AI-assisted software workflows from local skill definitions
Adds plugin runtime entry points so DSH can discover and load the skill pack automatically
Provides workflow-oriented prompts/tasks (for example TDD, debugging, code review, planning)
Supports installation/packaging through DSH plugin configuration and manifest metadata

reasons.code: Plugin is a DSH package that ports 20 skills and relies on `index.js`/`dsh.bundle` for loading.
Manifest and entry fields (`dsh.bundle`, `main`) indicate plugin integration with DeepSeek Harness runtime.
Repository tree includes `skills/`, `hooks/`, `bin/`, `docs/`, and plugin files needed for skill registration.
Readme describes automatic skill discovery and scene-based invocation by the agent after install.
